body.name: Complete observed-law-preserving FFRCISTG completion class
body.construction: \(\mathfrak F(P)=\{Q:Q(O\in B)=P(O\in B)\ \forall B\subseteq\Omega,\ Q(O=O^d,\Gamma_d)=Q(\Gamma_d)\ \forall d\in\mathcal D,\ Q(A_h=a,\mathcal C_h\in B,H=h)=e_h(a)Q(\mathcal C_h\in B,H=h)\ \forall h,a,B,\ Q(O^d=x)=\prod_{v\in\mathcal V_d}\kappa^d_{Q,v}(x_v\mid x_{\operatorname{pa}_d(v)})\ \forall d,x,\ \kappa^d_{Q,v}(\cdot\mid u)=\kappa^{d'}_{Q,v}(\cdot\mid u')\text{ whenever }(d,u)\sim_v(d',u')\text{ and both parent fibers have positive probability}\}\)
